ei.subject: 수능특강Light 영어
ei.title: Acting in Haste Comes at a High Cost

fullPassage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.

questions.passage: The desire to (A)[rush / pause] into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people (B)[overestimate / underestimate] what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking (C)[advantage / notice] of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① rush - overestimate - advantage: 무언가에 '서두르며', 단기간 성과를 '과대평가'하고, 남들이 '이용'할 위험이 있다는 원문.
❌ ② pause - overestimate - advantage: '멈추다'는 성급함의 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ rush - underestimate - advantage: '과소평가'는 원문의 overestimate와 반대.
❌ ④ rush - overestimate - notice: take notice of(주목하다)는 take advantage of(이용하다)와 의미가 다름.
det.tip: rush into(~에 서두르다). overestimate(과대평가) ↔ underestimate(과소평가). take advantage of(이용하다).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a (A)[lack / abundance] of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to (B)[relieve / increase] pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to (C)[overpaying / saving] for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ lack - relieve - overpaying: 비전의 '부족'을 보여주고, 고통을 '덜려는' 시도이며, 자산에 '과다 지불'하게 된다는 원문.
❌ ① abundance - relieve - overpaying: '풍부함'은 부족의 반대.
❌ ② lack - increase - overpaying: '늘리다'는 고통을 덜려는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ④ lack - relieve - saving: '절약'은 과다 지불과 반대.
det.tip: lack(부족) ↔ abundance(풍부). relieve(덜다) ↔ increase(늘리다). overpay(과다 지불) ↔ save(절약).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be (A)[driven / calmed] by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and (B)[underestimate / overestimate] what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you (C)[risk / ensure] others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② driven - underestimate - risk: 성급함이 두려움에 의해 '추동'되고, 장기 성과를 '과소평가'하며, 남에게 이용당할 '위험'이 있다는 원문.
❌ ① calmed - underestimate - risk: '진정된'은 두려움에 의해 추동된다는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ driven - overestimate - risk: 장기 성과를 또 '과대평가'하면 앞의 overestimate와 중복되어 대비 구조가 깨짐.
❌ ④ driven - underestimate - ensure: '보장하다'는 위험을 무릅쓰는 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: driven by(~에 의해 추동된). overestimate ↔ underestimate 대비 구조. risk + V-ing(~할 위험을 무릅쓰다).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to ①<u>relieve</u> pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to ②<u>overpaying</u> for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great ③<u>deals</u> out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be ④<u>worse</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① relieve: 고통을 '덜다' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② overpaying: '과다 지불' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ deals: 좋은 '거래'가 있다 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ worse: 원문은 better(더 나은). 다음에 오는 거래가 '더 나쁠' 수 있다는 건 성급함을 경계하는 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: better(더 나은) ↔ worse(더 나쁜). 기회는 계속 온다는 긍정적 메시지.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a ①<u>lack</u> of clarity of vision and values. det.analysis:
❌ ① lack: 비전의 '부족' — 원문 그대로.
✅ ② underestimate: 원문은 overestimate(과대평가하다). 단기간에 달성할 수 있는 것을 '과소평가'한다면 뒤의 underestimate와 대비가 안 됨.
❌ ③ risk: 남에게 이용당할 '위험' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ better: '더 나은' 거래 — 원문 그대로.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of ①<u>clarity</u> of vision and values. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and ③<u>consumables</u>, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you ④<u>seize</u> this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① clarity: 비전의 '명확함' 부족 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② lifetime: '일생' 동안의 성취 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ consumables: '소모품'에 과다 지불 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ seize: 원문은 miss(놓치다). 이 거래를 '잡으면' 다른 것이 온다는 건 놓쳐도 괜찮다는 원문 논리와 반대.
det.tip: miss(놓치다) ↔ seize(잡다). 놓쳐도 다른 기회가 온다는 메시지.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② advantage: take advantage of(이용하다)는 관용 표현. 성급하면 남들이 '이용'할 위험.
❌ ① care: take care of(돌보다)는 이 맥락과 무관.
❌ ③ control: take control of(통제하다)는 의미가 다름.
❌ ④ pride: take pride in(자부심)은 of와 결합 불가.
det.tip: take advantage of = ~을 이용하다. 성급함이 남에게 이용당할 빌미가 됨.

❌ ① Patience: '인내'는 과다 지불을 초래하지 않음.
❌ ② Confidence: '자신감'은 두려움에 추동되지 않음.
❌ ③ Generosity: '관대함'은 맥락과 무관.

❌ ② excess: '과잉'은 lack of와 결합하면 비전이 과하게 부족하다는 어색한 의미.

❌ ④ memory: '기억'의 부족은 성급함과 무관.
det.tip: lack of clarity = 명확함의 부족. 서두르면 비전과 가치관이 흐려진다.

det.korean: 성급한 행동은 높은 대가를 치르게 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② comes at a high cost: 과다 지불·이용당함 등 '높은 대가'가 성급함의 결과라는 본문 논지.
❌ ① guarantees the best possible outcome: '최선의 결과를 보장한다'는 본문과 반대.
❌ ③ is the only way to succeed quickly: '빨리 성공하는 유일한 방법'은 본문 주장과 반대.
❌ ④ shows strong leadership qualities: '강한 리더십'은 본문 맥락과 무관.
det.tip: 본문 전체가 성급함의 부정적 결과를 나열 → '높은 대가'.
